title: Read symbol in a lane configuration
statement: For any base configuration, work tape, optional state, integer frontier $z$, and lists $l,r$ of possibly blank symbols, the symbol read by the head on that work tape in the associated lane configuration is the first entry of $r$, or blank if $r$ is empty.
replaced:
In every single-lane configuration, the symbol read on the active lane is the first
entry of the unprocessed list, or blank if that list is empty.
